The '''Frozen Footpath''' was a roadway that ran through the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], joining [[Dorn Base]] to the [[Forward Bunker]] and then onward to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] other outposts. The trail ran south of the [[Windchapped Ridge]].
